verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents threshold-based Triggers and SLO burn alerts. Notifications can be routed to Slack, PagerDuty, Microsoft Teams, or custom webhooks, with templated payloads and examples for OpsGenie and incident.io. Alerting on all three signal types is only implied by its traces/logs/metrics ingestion. Missing for 10: any evidence of notification grouping or deduplication, silencing or muting of alerts, explicit confirmation that triggers work across all signal types, and independent hands-on corroboration.
